description: Unit tests for the HeaderValidator component in HTTP/2 header validation, covering header validation rules, pseudo-headers, and special cases.

classes.name: HeaderValidator
classes.description: Class responsible for validating HTTP/2 headers according to protocol rules.

methods.name: ValidateSingleHeader
methods.description: Validates a single header field and returns its validation status.

methods.name: SetMaxFieldSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum allowed size for header fields.

methods.name: FinishHeaderBlock
methods.description: Finalizes the header block validation, checking for required pseudo-headers and consistency.

methods.name: content_length
methods.description: Returns the parsed content length if available.

methods.name: status_header
methods.description: Returns the value of the :status pseudo-header.

methods.name: IsValidHeaderValue
methods.description: Checks if a header value is valid according to header value rules.

methods.name: SetObsTextOption
methods.description: Configures how obs-text (non-ASCII) characters are handled in header values.

methods.name: StartHeaderBlock
methods.description: Begins validation of a new header block.
